note: Potentially affected = geometric overlap with the model's predicted flood class; not confirmed damage. No reference damage map used.

rules.road: OSM way clipped to AOI; affected if length inside flood >= 10.0 m (prototype rule, not calibrated)
rules.bridge: highway way with bridge!=no; 'affected' = intersects predicted flood (length inside > 0.01 m); near_flood within 20.0 m
rules.building: affected if footprint area inside flood > 0.01 m² (point: covered)
rules.status: prototype rules; overlap with predicted flood is not confirmed damage
